summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, announcing a US$196.3 million budget for the development of the Chaarat ZAAV gold project in Kyrgyzstan via a news release. The filing details a construction plan and schedule for a joint venture (70% Silvercorp, 30% Kyrgyzaltyn) and outlines expenditures for 2026 (US$57 million) and 2027 (US$139 million). It is a routine operational update, not a special situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or corporate restructuring.
